uci_pilot.adjudication: checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material, automatic/claimable draws, or draw at maximum plies; no evaluation adjudication
uci_pilot.forfeit_rule: engine exception, timeout, null move in a live position, or illegal move loses immediately
uci_pilot.decision_rule: protocol gate passes only with zero candidate illegal moves, crashes, and timeouts; strength is reported without a win-rate threshold
